name: @node-agent/shell
description: The shell node: reads and writes files, searches, and runs commands across paths accessible to the local process

node.desc: Read and write local files at absolute or relative paths, and run commands

path.description: the file to read (absolute, or relative to the workspace root)

read.description: Read one file as plain text (cut with a marker when too long)

write.description: Create or overwrite a file (parent directories are created)

old.description: the exact text to replace; must be unique unless replaceAll

new.description: what to put in its place

edit.description: Replace a snippet instead of rewriting the whole file

path.description: the directory to list (default: the workspace root)

list.description: List one directory: d for directories / f for files + byte size

path.description: where to start (default: the workspace root)
the directory to search (default: the workspace root)

glob.description: only search files matching this glob

grep.description: Find by content: returns path:line: the line

path.description: the directory to list (default: the workspace)

depth.description: how many levels to expand (default 1, max 4); a directory at the last level carries no children

files-tree.description: List a directory for the file browser: name, type, size and mtime per entry, JSON — always at any accessible absolute or relative path

path.description: the file to read (absolute or relative to the workspace)

files-read.description: Read one file for the preview: text with its line count and revision, an image as a data URL, or a structured refusal for binary / oversized files

path.description: the file to save (absolute or relative to the workspace)

expectedRevision.description: the revision the edit started from; the save is refused when the file has moved past it (omit only to overwrite on purpose)

files-write.description: Save one file from the page: at any accessible absolute or relative path, refused for the deny-list names a write may not touch, and refused when expectedRevision is stale — answers with the new revision

dir.description: the local package directory, absolute or relative to the workspace (default: the workspace)

version.description: override the package version for this publish

overwrite.description: replace a version that is already published

publish.description: Pack a local node package and publish it through the store node on this bus

cwd.description: where to run it (default: the workspace root)

yield_ms.description: how long to wait before handing control back (default 10000, max 30000); a command still running comes back as a session handle

timeout_ms.description: hard timeout: kill it here (without it only the 30-minute ceiling applies)

max_output.description: most characters to return this time (default 4000)

exec.description: Run a command; a short one returns exit/stdout/stderr, a long one returns a session handle

path.description: the node package directory, or an entry file inside it, relative to the workspace

cwd.description: where to start it (default: the package directory, or the directory containing path)

args.description: arguments for a plain entry script; a node package is started through the SDK runner and takes none

name.description: the bus name to register under (default: the package's node.id, or the entry file name for a plain script)

yield_ms.description: how long to wait before handing control back (default 10000, max 30000); a node still running comes back as a session handle

timeout_ms.description: hard timeout: kill it here (without it only the 30-minute ceiling applies)

max_output.description: most characters to return this time (default 4000)

run-node.description: Start a local node package (or a plain entry script) against this bus: a package runs through the SDK runner under its node.id (or name), a script gets the bus URL, token and NODE_AGENT_NODE_NAME; a long-running node comes back as a session handle

list-local-running-nodes.description: List the nodes this shell started with run-node (kind, bus name, package entry, session) and whether each is still running

name.description: the name run-node registered: the bus id for a package, the name argument for a plain script

signal.description: signal to send first (default SIGTERM; SIGKILL skips the grace period)

kill-node.description: Stop a node started by run-node, named by its run-node name or its session id; waits for it to leave

session_id.description: the session id exec returned, e.g. s1

chars.description: what to write to stdin; omit it to just read new output

max_output.description: most characters to return this time (default 4000)

write-stdin.description: Send input to a session / read what it has produced since the last read

sessions.description: List the long-running sessions on this node

signal.description: which signal to send (default SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 2 seconds)

kill-session.description: Stop a session that is still running

reload.description: read this tenant's saved permissions again instead of answering from the copy this process keeps

permissions.description: Read the capability switches: one row per capability, on or off, and why they are what they are

caps.description: one switch per capability: { "exec": false } refuses shell.exec to every caller

callers.description: the same switches said as who may call: { "exec": ["agent"] }; an empty list is nobody, null allows everyone

set-permissions.description: Save the capability switches; a capability that is off refuses its caller before it runs

action.description: what to do; defaults to list

id.description: the command to change or delete (its name also works)

name.description: the name run-custom uses: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore

command.description: the /bin/sh script to run, exactly as written

cwd.description: where it runs, as exec takes a cwd: relative to the workspace unless absolute

timeoutMs.description: its own deadline in milliseconds (at most 30 minutes)

env.description: extra variable names to hand the command from the shell environment (never NODE_AGENT_*)

custom-commands.description: List, add, change or delete a user-defined command saved on this node

args.description: words for the command, reaching it as $1, $2, … and as SHELL_CUSTOM_ARGS (JSON) - never pasted into the script

timeout_ms.description: hard timeout for this call, under the command own deadline and the 30-minute ceiling

yield_ms.description: how long to wait before handing back a session (default 10000, max 30000)

max_output.description: most characters to return this time (default 4000)

run-custom.description: Run a user-defined command by name, with arguments that cannot become shell code

ui.description: Read and write files, run commands (long ones become sessions)
